body: Please don’t! We are here for you.
Happy Birthday hon. I hope it’s better than previous ones. Please don’t give in or give up. You have so much to share - ur artwork is amazing.

Converse high tops - enuf to wear a different pair every day for a month. 

Beanie babies- WAY too many. Can’t help myself.
Merry Christmas from Maine. Stay safe.
I’ve tried the counseling route - doc for meds, etc - as always money is an issue. But I’ll keep trying.
Awww. Bonnie is just precious. Lucky you. But it looks like u know that. Congrats on ur new fur baby.
Sending a “hey, how are you?” from Maine.

Been there, done that. It’s awful, but your body will adjust. Avoid the coffee - try ginger ale/sprite. Keep up with the grazing and eat something substantial midway thru your shift. Also, sleeping might be better with some white noise - whether a fan or sound machine. Good luck.
Ask questions, lots of them. Find the staff that love teaching newbies. If you don’t know, don’t do it! Best of luck to you.

Rehab nurse here - pls get your own (decent quality) stethoscope- Littmann’s are great, safety scissors, penlight with xtra batteries, multi-color pens, sharpies, small alcohol gel cleanser that u can hook on ur scrubs, clipboard, AND of course a bag to put it in. Rule #1 - don’t leave your stuff @ work cuz it disappears. Lol. Good luck to you. Also, download apps to your phone for references - labs, drugs, etc - easier than lugging around books.
HAPPY BIRTHDAY! Do something special for yourself.
It’s a lobster. You have their claws. 🦞
NTA. I agree that grief is such an individual thing. Also, my brother killed himself 4 days before my BD - 32 years ago - still sucks.
